hero.subtitle: Day cruises from Skala to Ithaca, Fiscardo and Zakynthos, with swim stops on every trip. Run by Captain Vangelis and his family.

boat.title: NIRIIS, built for these waters
boat.body:
NIRIIS is the Captain's sixth boat, built in 2017 after thirty years of daily cruises from Skala. Her Volvo Penta IPS engines run very quietly, so what you hear is the sea. Stabilisers cut rolling by up to 70%.

The main saloon is air-conditioned, with large windows. In the saloon and on the upper deck, half-moon seats wrap around tables, so each family or group sits together. There are four toilets, two bars, a diving platform and a water slide. The life rafts release automatically, as on ocean-going ships.

kalypso.title: Kalypso Star
kalypso.body: Kalypso Star is a semi-submarine trimaran built in France, with 49 seats in the central hall facing large underwater windows for watching marine life. The upper deck seats another 49 for drinks at sunset. Trips run on request.

fiscardo.name: Fiscardo & Sami
fiscardo.tagline: Kefalonia's coast, film locations and lunch in Fiscardo
fiscardo.summary: Sail up the Kefalonia coast past Makria Petra and Antisamos, with time in Sami for coffee or a bus trip to Melissani Lake. Then stop for lunch in Fiscardo and swim at Mini Myrtos, where the boat lands right on the beach.
highlights: Antisamos and the Captain Corelli coast
Coffee in Sami, or Melissani by bus
Lunch and a stroll in Fiscardo

stops.poros: Pick-up on request at 09:20, at the ferry quay (not by the cafés). The boat stops for only a few minutes, so please be on time.
stops.makriaPetra: Makria Petra, known as the Blue Lagoon, is the first sight along the coast.
stops.antisamos: Antisamos is the beach from the film Captain Corelli's Mandolin.
stops.sami: You have an hour and a half for coffee and shopping in Sami, where most of Captain Corelli's Mandolin was filmed. Buses wait for anyone who wants to visit Melissani Lake (the bus and entrance are not included; entrance is €15 for adults and €10 for ages 6–18, students and over-65s).
stops.gorgotas: In Gorgotas bay, you pass the jetty from the film.
stops.fiscardo: Fiscardo was the only village the 1953 earthquake did not destroy, and yachts moor in its harbour. You have almost two hours for lunch and a stroll.
stops.miniMyrtos: At Mini Myrtos (Koutsoupia), the boat lands right on the beach for your swim.
stops.return: If you boarded at Poros, you're back there at 17:30.

fiscardo.goodFor: First-timers, families and anyone who loves villages and film locations
included: A swim at Mini Myrtos (the boat lands on the beach)

ithacaVathiKioni.name: Ithaca: Vathi & Kioni
ithacaVathiKioni.tagline: Vathi, Kioni and a swim at Gidaki
ithacaVathiKioni.summary: A full day on Ithaca, with an hour and a half each in Vathi, the island's capital, and Kioni, a preserved 16th-century village. You swim twice: at Gidaki, a turquoise beach reached only by sea, and at Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra.
highlights: Gidaki beach, reached only by sea
Vathi and the statue of Odysseus
A swim at Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra

stops.poros: Pick-up on request at 09:20, at the ferry quay (not by the cafés). The boat stops for only a few minutes, so please be on time.
stops.gidaki: Gidaki is a turquoise beach on Ithaca with no road down to it. Swim, dive from the platform or try the water slide.
stops.vathi: You have an hour and a half in Vathi, Ithaca's capital. Look out for the Lazaretto islet with the Church of the Saviour, the statue of Odysseus, the archaeological and folklore museums, and the Venetian-style buildings rebuilt after the 1953 earthquake.
stops.kioni: Kioni is a preserved 16th-century village with three old windmills. Its tavernas serve fresh fish, which makes it the place for lunch.
stops.aiGianni: At Cape Ai Gianni, look for caves and wild goats on cliffs about 70 m high.
stops.miniMyrtos: Your second swim, at Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra.
stops.return: If you boarded at Poros, you're back there at 17:30.

ithacaVathiKioni.goodFor: Anyone after villages, history and two swims in one day
ithacaVathiKioni.quote: Keep Ithaka always in your mind.
included: Two swim stops: Gidaki, then Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra

ithacaVathi.name: Ithaca: Vathi
ithacaVathi.tagline: Two hours in Vathi, two swims and an earlier return
ithacaVathi.summary: Our shorter day on Ithaca: two hours in Vathi, with swims at Gidaki and at Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra. The fare is lower, and you're back in Skala by 16:45.
highlights: Gidaki beach, reached only by sea
A swim at Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra

stops.poros: Pick-up on request at 09:20, at the ferry quay (not by the cafés). The boat stops for only a few minutes, so please be on time.
stops.gidaki: A swim at Gidaki, the turquoise Ithaca beach you can only reach by sea.
stops.vathi: Two hours in Vathi, Ithaca's capital, to see the Lazaretto islet, the statue of Odysseus and the Venetian-style buildings rebuilt after the 1953 earthquake.
stops.miniMyrtos: Your second swim, at Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra.
stops.return: If you boarded at Poros, you're back there at 16:30.

ithacaVathi.goodFor: Families with young children and anyone who wants a gentler day
included: Two swim stops: Gidaki, then Mini Myrtos or Makria Petra

zakynthos.name: Zakynthos: Shipwreck & Blue Caves
zakynthos.tagline: Shipwreck bay before the big boats, then the Blue Caves
zakynthos.summary: Cross to Zakynthos and reach Shipwreck (Navagio) bay around 10:00, before the big boats arrive. After the Blue Caves, a swim at Platys Gialos and two hours in Alykes for lunch, you're back in Skala at about 15:00.

stops.skinari: About 40 minutes after leaving Skala, we reach Cape Skinari on Zakynthos.
stops.shipwreck: We reach Shipwreck (Navagio) bay around 10:00, before the big boats arrive. We stay about 40–50 m off the beach for the view and photos. Landing and swimming on Shipwreck beach are no longer permitted.
stops.blueCaves: Along the coast, you pass the ruined walls of St Andrew's monastery, then the Blue Caves. We stop nearby at Platys Gialos for a swim of about 30 minutes.
stops.alykes: Two hours in Alykes, 12:00 to 14:00, for lunch and a swim from the sandy beach.
stops.return: Times are approximate and depend on the sea on the day.

zakynthos.goodFor: Confident sea travellers and keen photographers

warning.title: A word from the Captain
warning.body: The west coast of Zakynthos faces the open sea, and even on a fine day there can be a swell. The Captain does not recommend this cruise for small children, older guests, pregnant women, people with limited mobility or anyone prone to seasickness; he suggests one of the other cruises instead. NIRIIS has stabilisers, but safety always comes first.

included: Shipwreck bay seen from the water
A swim at Platys Gialos, near the Blue Caves

bbq.name: Mini Myrtos BBQ cruise
bbq.tagline: Swims, a beach barbecue with wine, and dancing on board
bbq.summary: Sail along the south-east coast to swim at Makria Petra, then on to Koutsoupia beach for another swim, a barbecue with plenty of food and wine, and beach games. Music and dancing on board round off the trip. Day or evening, times flexible.
highlights: BBQ with food and wine included
Beach games, music and dancing on board

stops.poros: Past Kako Lagadi and Poros harbour
stops.makriaPetra: A swim at Makria Petra, with the water slide and the diving platform.
stops.koutsoupia: At Koutsoupia, also known as Mini Myrtos, you swim, play beach games and sit down to a barbecue. Food and wine are included, and there is plenty of both.
stops.return: Music and dancing on board all the way back to Skala.

bbq.goodFor: Groups, celebrations and a send-off at the end of your holiday
included: Swims at Makria Petra and Koutsoupia
BBQ with plenty of food and wine
